name: Closing GPU gaps and memory-bound kernel time converts wall clock into optimizer steps
statement: Under a fixed charged-training-seconds budget the metric is bought with optimizer steps. The profile shows step time is now dominated by two recoverable costs rather than by useful matmul: the GPU runs no kernel for ~43% of wall, and ~26.7% of the kernel time that does run is memory-bound RMSNorm and small elementwise work spread over ~572 launches per step. Removing either returns wall clock, which the fixed budget spends as additional steps, which lowers val_bpb along the same token law that already explained the v2b to v2c jump.

nodes.label: kernel-level change: CUDA graph capture, kernel fusion, or a cheaper cross-entropy
GPU idle fraction within a step (launch/dispatch bubbles)
GPU kernel time spent on memory-bound norm and elementwise work
optimizer steps completed within the 300s charged budget

assumptions.statement: A kernel-level change alters only how the same arithmetic is scheduled, not the arithmetic itself, so val_bpb at matched step count is unchanged and the entire effect flows through the step mediator.
The measured idle fraction is a property of this workload rather than of the profiler or of co-tenancy.

alternatives: The 43% idle is mostly profiler overhead and foreign-tenant preemption, in which case no local kernel change recovers it and the correct lever is scheduling, not code.
The gaps are caused on the CPU by the best-fit packing loop in the consumer, in which case the fix is the packer and not the kernels.
torch.compile has already captured the available fusion, so the memory-bound share is irreducible at this model size.
predictions: num_steps rises measurably before val_bpb improves.
mfu_percent rises together with num_steps; a change that lifts steps without lifting MFU was throughput bought elsewhere.
val_bpb at matched step count is unchanged, because no arithmetic changed.
falsifiers: val_bpb improves with no increase in num_steps, refuting the step-exposure mediator.
num_steps rises but val_bpb does not fall, which would contradict the token law that held across v2b to v2c.
A profile taken after the intervention shows the idle fraction unchanged, refuting the gap mediator even if the metric moved.
